import sys

oo = 1000000000

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    m = int(data[1])
    if n > m:
        n, m = m, n
    size = 1 << n
    curr = [ [oo] * size for _ in range(size) ]
    for i in range(size):
        curr[0][i] = 0
    for j in range(m):
        next_ = [ [oo] * size for _ in range(size) ]
        limit = 1 if j == m - 1 else size
        for c0 in range(size):
            curr_row0 = curr[c0]
            for c1 in range(size):
                cur_val = curr_row0[c1]
                if cur_val != oo:
                    for c2 in range(limit):
                        done = 0
                        for i in range(n):
                            if not (c1 >> i) & 1:
                                up = i - 1
                                down = i + 1
                                if up >= 0 and (c1 >> up) & 1:
                                    done |= 1 << i
                                if down < n and (c1 >> down) & 1:
                                    done |= 1 << i
                                if (c0 >> i) & 1:
                                    done |= 1 << i
                                if (c2 >> i) & 1:
                                    done |= 1 << i
                        next_row1 = next_[c1]
                        new_val = cur_val + n - bin(done).count('1')
                        if new_val < next_row1[c2]:
                            next_row1[c2] = new_val
        curr = next_
    res = oo
    for row in curr:
        for val in row:
            if val < res:
                res = val
    print(n * m - res)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
